title: Optimal Convex Optimization with Inexact Second-Order Oracles
summary: In this paper, we present a novel second-order method called Accelerated Inexact Newton Extragradient (AINE) for convex optimization using $δ$-inexact Hessians. We show that AINE can find an $ε$-solution in the inexact second-order oracle (ISO) complexity of $\mathcal{O}( (δ/ε)^{1/2} + (L_2/ε)^{2/7} )$ when the Hessian is $L_2$-Lipschitz continuous, and a better complexity of $\mathcal{O}( (δ/ε)^{1/2} + (L_3/ε)^{1/5} )$ when the third-order derivative is $L_3$-Lipschitz continuous.
